new_bio: Kohra (Madhav Shorey) is a New Delhi-based DJ and producer. He founded Qilla Records in 2011. He started as a rock and metal drummer, studied at Swinburne University in Melbourne, and began in the live electronica band Jalebee Cartel. His productions have come out on Sol Selectas, Traum, Parquet, Motek, Blindfold and Tulipa. His debut album akhõ came out on Qilla in July 2020, inspired by a 17th-century Gujarati poet, and Qilla's 100th release, the 35-track compilation Chakravyūh, followed on 20 May 2024.
notes: Dropped: Beatport Top 100 claim, supporter list, stage-sharing list, Steyoyoke and Particles, first-on-vinyl, Sacred Alchemy venues, vinyl/festival plans, 'international attention'. Corrected: poet is Gujarati poet Akho, not Kabir. Digweed: Mixmag Asia says five tracks on his Bunker radio show; Beatportal says half, so new_bio omits Digweed. Jalebee Cartel: Beatportal text says 'one of his country's first widely recognized live electronica bands', bio's 'India's first' overstated (new_bio makes no 'first' claim). Wild City article and Wild City Qilla directory timed out so not read.
